---
description: Build the first usable requirements-to-recommendation interface
---

Work only in the current local branch/worktree. Do not create branches, push commits, or open pull requests.
Build an accessible responsive configurator that asks for requirements rather than products first.

Initial inputs:
- application/vehicle class
- available electrical cabinet dimensions when known
- system weight budget
- project budget
- AC loads and simultaneous-use assumptions
- DC loads
- future loads
- expected daily energy use or usage patterns
- solar availability and roof/portable array options
- alternator charging availability
- shore power requirements
- desired off-grid duration
- environmental notes
- preferred complexity/skill level

Results must compare eligible system voltages rather than treating one as standard. For each candidate architecture show engineering fit, major current levels, cable-size implications when data supports it, conversion requirements, cost/weight implications where data exists, warnings, and a `Why?` trace.

Do not use fake live pricing. Clearly label missing information.
